description: Look up a U.S. civil aircraft in the FAA registry by tail number (N-number) or Mode S hex code: make, model, year, registration status and dates, and the registrant when it is an organisation (company, LLC, government). Aircraft registered to private individuals are confirmed as such without the person’s name. Also gives the N-number’s cancelled registrations from the FAA deregistered aircraft file (cancel date, export country, earlier aircraft and organisation owners), including for numbers no longer on the register.

mode_s.description: Mode S transponder code as 6 hex characters, e.g. A1B2C3.

n_number.description: Tail number, e.g. N12345 or N123AB.

name: aircraft_owner
title: Who owns this aircraft?
